videos.title: Birth Number and Life Path, Free (explainer)
videos.note: PROMOTED consumer explainer — the first paid post, and the first video with no V-number. 🔴 No V-number by design (owner 2026-08-12): V-numbers are coupled to angles.json, and pickAngle's 21-day window plus the no-recycled-ideas rule both key off angleId. A video with no angle would pollute that sequence. Own prefix, like PIN01. 🎯 Targets CONSUMERS, not practitioners (owner 2026-08-12). The practitioner cut is parked until Numevix Studio is close — it had no destination, and Promote cannot target an occupation. ⚠️ Accepted with eyes open: this pays to amplify a funnel with a measured 0–1s leak (every TikTok post reads 'stopped watching at 0:01', 1.7–2.0s avg watch, 0 comments ever). Promotion buys impressions into that; it does not fix the first second. ⛔ Do not re-litigate. 🔴 Every claim is the product's own copy, read off the live app: /try says 'One free chart per day, no account needed'; anon-chart renders Driver/Basic, Conductor/Destiny, Compound, Missing, Combinations/Yogas, grid and forecast, labelled 'Free preview chart, not saved'. The AI reading is NOT free — it needs a free account via /api/claim — and neither the video nor the caption claims otherwise. 📐 snap structure (14.2s class), cipherV15, payload frame 53 (1.777s — the same beat V30/V32/V33 pay out on). Fingerprint snap|140|centered|mono, unused in the 14-day window. Shorter is used deliberately here: it does not improve the hook, but it improves the completion metric the PAID delivery system reads. 🔴 First render shipped a 1.73s HOLE at 10.3s — makeValueScenes reserves scenes.montage frames and the component never rendered them. Same class as V33. Fixed by exporting Montage from ViralVideo and rendering the slot. 🪤 The frame scanner FALSE-POSITIVED on this video's light `mono` palette: a short dark line on a near-white ground falls under an absolute stddev floor calibrated on dark frames. Use a floor relative to the video's OWN median stddev, and look at the frames before believing either answer. 🎯 COPY RETARGETED 2026-08-12 (owner: 'target bigger audience, use birth number / life path number type words'). 'Driver and Conductor' and 'compound number' are OUR internal ruleset vocabulary and almost nobody searches them. The relabel is EXACT, verified in modules/numerology-engine/core.ts, which names them itself: computeDriver = 'Driver / Root / Mulank: reduce the birth day' = BIRTH NUMBER; computeConductor = 'Conductor / Destiny / Life-Path: reduce the compound' = LIFE PATH. ⛔ Never relabel a number without re-reading that file — calling the Driver a life path number would be flatly wrong. 'Your next 5 years' is measured: app/try/page.tsx calls computeForecastRange with fromYear thisYear-1, toYear thisYear+4. 'Your Vedic grid' deliberately NOT broadened — standing brand term, renaming it is the owner's call.
